g4s.name: G4S
g4s.description: G4S is a British multinational private security company headquartered in London, England. It was formed in July 2004 by the amalgamation of London-based Securicor and Danish firm Group 4 Falck. G4S is a subsidiary of Allied Universal.

gazprom.name: Gazprom
gazprom.description: PJSC Gazprom is a Russian state-owned multinational energy corporation headquartered in the Lakhta Center in Saint Petersburg. The company is named as a contraction of the Russian words for gas industry. In December 2024, Gazprom ranked fifth among the largest companies in Russia by market capitalization.

golden-agri-resources.name: Golden Agri-Resources
golden-agri-resources.description: Golden-Agri Resources (GAR) is a Singaporean palm oil company listed on the Singapore Stock Exchange since 1999. It is led by CEO Franky Widjaja of the Sinar Mas family. The company has subsidiaries including Alnoor and board members with political backgrounds.

gap-inc.name: Gap Inc.
gap-inc.description: The Gap, Inc., headquartered in San Francisco, California, is an American multinational clothing and accessories retailer. It operates four primary divisions: Gap, Banana Republic, Old Navy, and Athleta, and is one of the largest apparel retailers in the United States.

geely-auto.name: Geely Auto
geely-auto.description: Geely Automobile Holdings Limited, known as Geely Auto, is a publicly traded automotive company incorporated in the Cayman Islands. Predominantly owned by Zhejiang Geely Holding, it owns the Geely Auto brand and partly owns Lynk & Co, Proton Cars, and Zeekr brands. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

great-wall-motor.name: Great Wall Motor
great-wall-motor.description: Great Wall Motor Company Limited (GWM) is a Chinese automobile manufacturer headquartered in Baoding, Hebei. It produces SUVs, pick-up trucks, and trucks, ranking among the top ten Chinese automobile manufacturers.

gazprom-neft.name: Gazprom Neft
gazprom-neft.description: Gazprom Neft is the third largest oil producer in Russia and ranks third in refining throughput. It is a subsidiary of Gazprom, which owns about 96% of its shares. The company is registered and headquartered in St. Petersburg after relocating its central offices from Moscow in 2011.

goodyear-tire-and-rubber-company.name: Goodyear Tire and Rubber Company
goodyear-tire-and-rubber-company.description: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company is an American multinational tire manufacturer headquartered in Akron, Ohio. It produces tires for various vehicles including automobiles, motorcycles, trucks, and aviation. The company also licenses its brand to bicycle tire manufacturers, resuming production after a break from 1976 to 2015.

gerdau.name: Gerdau
gerdau.description: Gerdau S.A. is the largest producer of long steel in the Americas and the 33rd largest steelmaker worldwide. The company uses mini mills, integrated mills, and direct reduced iron plants, with 71% of its steel made from recycled scrap. In 2023, sales were evenly split between Brazil and North America.

general-mills.name: General Mills
general-mills.description: General Mills, Inc. is an American multinational manufacturer and marketer of branded consumer foods. Founded in Minneapolis, it is headquartered in Golden Valley, Minnesota, and originally gained fame as a large flour miller.

grupo-televisa.name: Grupo Televisa
grupo-televisa.description: Grupo Televisa, S.A.B., known as Televisa, is a Mexican telecommunications and broadcasting company and the largest in Hispanic America. It is a major mass media corporation producing Spanish-language content.

grifols.name: Grifols
grifols.description: Grifols, S.A. is a global healthcare company founded in Barcelona, Spain, in 1909. It is a leading producer of plasma-derived medicines and employs over 23,800 people. Grifols serves more than 110 countries and maintains a direct presence in over 30 countries.

grendene.name: Grendene
grendene.description: Grendene is a Brazilian company known as the world's largest manufacturer of sandals. It was founded by Alexandre Grendene Bartelle and his twin brother Pedro Grendene Bartelle.

gilead-sciences.name: Gilead Sciences
gilead-sciences.description: Gilead Sciences, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company based in Foster City, California. It focuses on developing antiviral drugs for diseases such as HIV/AIDS, hepatitis, influenza, and COVID-19, as well as medicines for oncology, inflammation, and cell therapy.

grupa-azoty-s-a.name: Grupa Azoty S.A.
grupa-azoty-s-a.description: Grupa Azoty S.A. is a major Polish chemical industry company headquartered in the Mościce district of Tarnów, in southeastern Poland. It operates in the chemical sector and is one of the leading companies in its industry in Poland.

gold-peak.name: Gold Peak
gold-peak.description: Gold Peak Technology Group Limited is a Hong Kong–based multinational corporation established in 1964. It produces batteries under brands like GP and GP Recyko, and owns speaker brands KEF and Celestion.

globalfoundries.name: GlobalFoundries
globalfoundries.description: GlobalFoundries Inc. is a multinational semiconductor technology development, design, and contract manufacturing company headquartered in Malta, New York. It was created from AMD's manufacturing arm divestiture in 2009 and is majority owned by Mubadala Investment Company.

gedeon-richter-ltd.name: Gedeon Richter Ltd.
gedeon-richter-ltd.description: Gedeon Richter Plc. is a Hungarian multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in Budapest. Founded in 1901 by pharmacist Gedeon Richter, it is listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the BUX Index.

goodbaby-international.name: Goodbaby International
goodbaby-international.description: Goodbaby International is a Chinese company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and headquartered in Shanghai. It designs, develops, markets, and sells a variety of children's products worldwide, including strollers and child seats.

groupe-bull.name: Groupe Bull
groupe-bull.description: Bull SAS is a French computer company headquartered in Les Clayes-sous-Bois near Paris. Founded in 1931, it has operated under various names and has a worldwide presence in over 100 countries, active in sectors including defense, finance, healthcare, manufacturing, public, and telecommunications.

gn-store-nord.name: GN Store Nord
gn-store-nord.description: GN Store Nord A/S is a Danish manufacturer of hearing aids, speakerphones, videobars, and headsets. The company is publicly listed on NASDAQ OMX Copenhagen.

gma-network-inc.name: GMA Network, Inc.
gma-network-inc.description: GMA Network Inc. is a Filipino media company based in Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines. It is primarily involved in radio and television broadcasting and has subsidiaries in various media-related businesses. The majority of its profits come from publicity and marketing incomes related to television distribution.

groupe-adp.name: Groupe ADP
groupe-adp.description: Groupe ADP is an international airport operator based in Paris, France. It owns and manages Parisian international airports including Charles de Gaulle, Orly, and Le Bourget, all under the Paris Aéroport brand since 2016.

godaddy.name: GoDaddy
godaddy.description: GoDaddy Inc. is an American internet domain registry, registrar, and web hosting company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. It serves primarily small and micro companies and manages over 62 million registered domains.

groupon.name: Groupon
groupon.description: Groupon, Inc. is an American e-commerce marketplace that connects subscribers with local merchants. It offers activities, travel, goods, and services across 13 countries.

groupe-tf1.name: Groupe TF1
groupe-tf1.description: Télévision Française 1 S.A., known as the TF1 Group, is a French media holding company. Its best-known property is the broadcast network TF1, launched in 1975 and privatized in 1987. The group is controlled with a 43% stake by industrial group Bouygues and is quoted on Euronext Paris.

getty-images.name: Getty Images
getty-images.description: Getty Images Holdings, Inc. is an American visual media company supplying stock images, editorial photography, video, and music. It serves creative professionals, media, and corporate clients with a library of over 477 million assets.

gafisa.name: Gafisa
gafisa.description: Gafisa is the fourth largest Brazilian residential construction and real estate company. Founded in 1954 and based in São Paulo, it inherited its brand and assets from Cimob Companhia Imobiliária. The company operates across Brazil.

gemfields.name: Gemfields
gemfields.description: Gemfields Group Ltd is a mining company incorporated in Guernsey and headquartered in London. It specializes in mining, grading, and selling colored gemstones, particularly emeralds and rubies. The company operates mining sites in Zambia and Mozambique, contributing significantly to global emerald and ruby supplies.

gopro.name: GoPro
gopro.description: GoPro, Inc. is an American technology company founded in 2002 and based in San Mateo, California. It manufactures action cameras and develops mobile apps and video-editing software, widely used for adventure sports and outdoor activities.

gilat-satellite-networks-ltd.name: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd.
gilat-satellite-networks-ltd.description: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. is an Israeli public company specializing in satellite-based broadband communications technology. It develops, manufactures, and markets ground-based satellite systems for global communication.

general-shopping-e-outlets.name: General Shopping e Outlets
general-shopping-e-outlets.description: General Shopping is a Brazilian shopping mall management company headquartered in São Paulo. Founded in 1989 and controlled by the Veronezi Family, it manages 9 shopping malls and 6 outlets with a significant gross leasable area. The company operates in retail real estate.

gungho-online-entertainment.name: GungHo Online Entertainment
gungho-online-entertainment.description: GungHo Online Entertainment, Inc. is a Japanese video game developer and publisher known for the mobile game Puzzle & Dragons. The company also hosts the Japanese server of Ragnarok Online through its Korean subsidiary Gravity. It is based in Japan and has generated most of its revenue from Puzzle & Dragons in the 2010s and 2020s.

gp-investments.name: GP Investments
gp-investments.description: GP Investments, Ltd is an investment firm in Latin America with a strong presence in asset management, mainly private equity funds. The firm's shares are listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and traded on BM&FBovespa via Brazilian Depositary Receipts.

grail.name: GRAIL
grail.description: GRAIL, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Menlo Park, California, founded in 2015. It develops early cancer screening tests for asymptomatic people and was a subsidiary of Illumina before being fully acquired in 2021.

g5-entertainment.name: G5 Entertainment
g5-entertainment.description: G5 Entertainment is a Swedish video game developer specializing in free-to-play mobile games.

gencell.name: GenCell
gencell.description: GenCell Ltd. is an Israeli company developing hydrogen alkaline based fuel cell systems and ammonia-based off-grid power solutions. Its products replace diesel generators with clean backup power for utilities, homeland security, healthcare, and automated industries.

genex-power.name: Genex Power
genex-power.description: Genex Power is an electricity generation company based in Australia.

greenland.name: Greenland
greenland.description: Greenland is an amusement park located in Arao City, Kumamoto, Japan, and is one of the largest on the island of Kyūshū. The Greenland Resort covers 300 hectares including the amusement park, golf course, hotel, onsen, and shopping mall. It is operated by Greenland Resort Co. Ltd., part of Saibu Gas Holdings Group.

goldwind.name: Goldwind
goldwind.description: Goldwind Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational wind turbine manufacturer headquartered in Beijing. It was formerly a state-owned enterprise with major shareholders including state-controlled corporations. Its founder, Wu Gang, held a seat in the 12th National People's Congress.

gf-securities-company-limited.name: GF Securities Company Limited
gf-securities-company-limited.description: GF Securities is a Chinese securities firm founded in 1991 and headquartered in Guangzhou. It provides large-scale comprehensive securities broking and trading services. By mid-2020, it was among China's four largest securities firms.

glorious-property-holdings.name: Glorious Property Holdings
glorious-property-holdings.description: Glorious Property Holdings Limited is a Shanghai-based property developer established in 1996. It holds a land bank of 13.6 square kilometers in major Chinese cities including Shanghai, Beijing, and Tianjin.

gmo-internet-group.name: GMO Internet Group
gmo-internet-group.description: GMO Internet Group, Inc. is a Japanese Internet company headquartered in Cerulean Tower, Shibuya, Tokyo. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and serves as the holding company of GMO Internet Group. Its founder, Masatoshi Kumagai, is among Japan's wealthiest individuals.

gunze.name: Gunze
gunze.description: Gunze Limited is a Japanese clothing brand with its registered head office in Ayabe, Kyoto Prefecture, and additional offices in Osaka and Tokyo. Established in 1896 by Tsurukichi Hatano, it was originally known as Gunze Silk Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

gala.name: Gala
gala.description: Gala Inc. is a holding company based in Tokyo, Japan, administering the GALA Group, which includes subsidiaries focused on MMORPG games, web design, and data mining. The group develops multiplayer online role-playing games and has companies in the United States, Japan, and South Korea.

ge-healthcare.name: GE HealthCare
ge-healthcare.description: GE HealthCare is an American health technology company based in Chicago, Illinois. It operates four divisions including medical imaging, ultrasound, patient care solutions, and pharmaceutical diagnostics.

ge-vernova.name: GE Vernova
ge-vernova.description: GE Vernova, Inc. is an energy equipment manufacturing and services company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It operates through segments including Power, Wind, and Electrification, providing technologies and solutions for electricity generation, transmission, and management.

golden-flake.name: Golden Flake
golden-flake.description: Golden Flake Snack Foods produces various snack foods including potato chips and cheese curls in the Southern United States. It is now part of Utz Quality Foods.

gmm-music.name: GMM Music
gmm-music.description: GMM Music Public Company Limited is a Thai music company operating as a subsidiary of GMM Grammy. It manages record labels, artist management services, and music distribution channels.

global-ime-bank.name: Global IME Bank
global-ime-bank.description: Global IME Bank Limited is a commercial bank based in Kathmandu, Nepal. It was formed in 2012 through the merger of IME Financial Institution Limited and Lord Buddha Finance Limited. The bank has expanded by acquiring 21 banking and financial institutions and operates branches nationwide.

getinge-ab.name: Getinge AB
getinge-ab.description: Getinge AB is a Swedish publicly traded medical technology company producing and distributing medical products and equipment for healthcare and life sciences. It operates in three business areas and has a significant market presence in the United States, China, and Western Europe.

gdev-inc.name: GDEV Inc.
gdev-inc.description: GDEV Inc. is a gaming and entertainment holding company headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus. It evolved from the video game company Nexters in 2023 and owns subsidiaries including Nexters Studio and Cubic Games. The company is known for mobile games such as Throne Rush and Hero Wars.

gd-power-development-company.name: GD Power Development Company
gd-power-development-company.description: GD Power Development Company is a subsidiary of China Guodian Corporation engaged in electric power and heat generation and supply. Founded in 1992, it is headquartered in Beijing, China, and was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1997.

gome-electrical-appliances.name: GOME Electrical Appliances
gome-electrical-appliances.description: GOME Retail Holdings Ltd., formerly GOME Electrical Appliances Holding Ltd., is one of the largest privately owned electrical appliance retailers in mainland China and Hong Kong. Founded in Beijing in 1987, it expanded beyond Beijing since 1999 and is incorporated in Bermuda.

galp-energia.name: Galp Energia
galp-energia.description: Galp Energia is a Portuguese multinational energy corporation headquartered in Lisbon. Founded in 1999 through a merger, it operates in oil and natural gas supply, exploration, refining, trading, logistics, retailing, and renewable energy.

gecina.name: Gecina
gecina.description: Gecina is a French real estate group owning and managing property holdings mainly in the Paris Region. It is a real estate investment trust listed on Euronext Paris, with a portfolio including offices, residential assets, and student residences.

genworth-financial.name: Genworth Financial
genworth-financial.description: Genworth Financial is an American financial services company headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. It offers life insurance, long-term care insurance, mortgage insurance, and annuities. The company operates primarily in the insurance sector.

geo-group.name: GEO Group
geo-group.description: The GEO Group, Inc. is an American private prison and mental health facility operator. It owns or manages 80,000 beds at 95 facilities across the United States, Australia, South Africa, and the United Kingdom. GEO is the largest prison operator in the United States and operates government-owned facilities under management contracts.

gk-software-ag.name: GK SOFTWARE AG
gk-software-ag.description: GK Software is a German technology company headquartered in Schöneck/Vogtland. It specializes in software and services for operating large retail company branches. The company focuses on enterprise software solutions.

gujarat-state-fertilizers-and-chemicals.name: Gujarat State Fertilizers and Chemicals
gujarat-state-fertilizers-and-chemicals.description: Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited (GSFC) is an Indian chemicals and fertilizers manufacturer headquartered in Vadodara. Founded in 1962, it is partly owned by the Government of Gujarat. The company produces fertilizers like diammonium phosphate and industrial products such as caprolactam and nylon 6.

gigaset.name: Gigaset
gigaset.description: Gigaset AG is a multinational corporation based in Munich, Germany. The summary does not specify its products or services but identifies it as a telecommunications industry company.

gildan-activewear.name: Gildan Activewear
gildan-activewear.description: Gildan Activewear Inc. is a Canadian manufacturer of branded clothing including blank activewear like t-shirts and hoodies. It supplies branded and private label socks to US retail companies and operates manufacturing facilities in Honduras and the Caribbean.

gpa.name: GPA
gpa.description: Companhia Brasileira de Distribuição, or GPA, is the largest Brazilian retailer of food, general merchandise, electronics, and home appliances. Its stores include supermarkets, hypermarkets, and home appliance outlets. The company is headquartered in São Paulo and is owned by Free Float.

gree-electric.name: Gree Electric
gree-electric.description: GREE Electric Appliances Inc. of Zhuhai is a Chinese home appliances manufacturer headquartered in Zhuhai, Guangdong province. It is the world's largest air-conditioner manufacturer and produces household and commercial air conditioners along with other appliances. The company has joint ventures with Daikin.

gac-group.name: GAC Group
gac-group.description: Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned automobile manufacturer headquartered in Guangzhou, Guangdong. It was the fifth largest automobile manufacturer in China as of 2021. The company operates in the automotive industry.

gudang-garam.name: Gudang Garam
gudang-garam.description: PT Gudang Garam Tbk is an Indonesian tobacco company known for its kretek products. It is Indonesia's largest tobacco manufacturer with a market share of nearly 33%. The company was founded in 1958 by Tjoa Ing Hwie, later known as Surya Wonowidjojo.

gaming-and-leisure-properties.name: Gaming and Leisure Properties
gaming-and-leisure-properties.description: Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. is a real estate investment trust specializing in casino properties based in Wyomissing, Pennsylvania. Formed in 2013 as a spin-off from Penn National Gaming, it owns 64 casino properties leased to other companies.

griffon-corporation.name: Griffon Corporation
griffon-corporation.description: Griffon Corporation is a multinational conglomerate based in New York City. It operates as a diversified management and holding company with subsidiaries including Ames True Temper, ClosetMaid, Clopay Building Products, and CornellCookson. Griffon has been publicly traded since 1961.

genting-hong-kong.name: Genting Hong Kong
genting-hong-kong.description: Genting Hong Kong Limited was a holding company headquartered in Hong Kong that operated cruise and resort businesses. It was part of the Genting Group and owned cruise lines such as Crystal Cruises, Dream Cruises, and Star Cruises, as well as shipyards MV Werften and Lloyd Werft.

green-dot-corporation.name: Green Dot Corporation
green-dot-corporation.description: Green Dot Corporation is a financial technology and bank holding company based in Austin, Texas. Founded in 1999, it is the largest prepaid debit card company by market capitalization and provides the technology platform for Apple Cash, Uber, and Intuit.

gentherm-incorporated.name: Gentherm Incorporated
gentherm-incorporated.description: Gentherm Incorporated is an American thermal management technologies company known for creating the first thermoelectrically heated and cooled automotive seat system. It supplies this technology to major car manufacturers including Ford and Toyota.

grabcad.name: GrabCAD
grabcad.description: GrabCAD, Inc. is a startup based in Cambridge, Massachusetts that developed a free cloud-based collaboration platform for engineering teams to manage, view, and share CAD files.

gongniu-group-corporation.name: Gongniu Group Corporation
gongniu-group-corporation.description: Gongniu Group, also known as Bull Group, is a Chinese manufacturer of civil electrical products. The company was co-founded by Ruan Liping and Ruan Xueping in 1995.

greaves-cotton.name: Greaves Cotton
greaves-cotton.description: Greaves Cotton Ltd. is an Indian engineering company founded in 1859. It operates in powertrain solutions, electric mobility, automotive components, and related services, with a distribution and retail network across India supported by over 20,000 mechanics.

glacier-bancorp-inc.name: Glacier Bancorp, Inc
glacier-bancorp-inc.description: Glacier Bancorp, Inc. is a regional multi-bank holding company headquartered in Kalispell, Montana. It offers personal and commercial banking services through 221 locations across several western U.S. states.

gartner.name: Gartner
gartner.description: Gartner, Inc. is a US-based research and advisory firm focusing on business and technology topics. It provides products and services through research reports, conferences, and consulting. Its clients include large corporations, government agencies, technology companies, and investment firms.

globus-medical.name: Globus Medical
globus-medical.description: Globus Medical, Inc. is a publicly traded orthopedic medical device company headquartered in Audubon, Pennsylvania. It designs, develops, and commercializes products to help surgeons promote healing in patients with musculoskeletal disorders.

greenhill-co.name: Greenhill & Co.
greenhill-co.description: Greenhill & Co., Inc. is an American investment banking advisory firm founded in 1996 in New York. It advises on mergers, acquisitions, restructurings, financings, and capital raisings across various industries.

global-industrial.name: Global Industrial
global-industrial.description: Global Industrial Company is based in Port Washington, New York, and provides industrial and MRO products through e-commerce websites and relationship marketers across North America. Its primary brand is Global Industrial.

guangzhou-zhujiang-brewery-group.name: Guangzhou Zhujiang Brewery Group
guangzhou-zhujiang-brewery-group.description: Zhujiang Brewery is a large state-owned Chinese enterprise established in 1985, dealing mainly in beer and related products. It operates one of the largest single-site production facilities in the world and produces Zhujiang Beer. Its headquarters is located in Haizhu District.

gogoro.name: Gogoro
gogoro.description: Gogoro Inc. is a Taiwanese company that developed a battery-swapping platform for electric two-wheel scooters and motorcycles. It also produces electric scooters and operates a rideshare service called GoShare in Taiwan and Japan.

golden-power-group.name: Golden Power Group
golden-power-group.description: Golden Power Group, established in 1972 in Hong Kong, is an industrial and chemical company. It was formerly known as Golden Power Industrial Limited. As of January 2016, the company had total assets of HKD 150 million.

greif-inc.name: Greif, Inc.
greif-inc.description: Greif, Inc. is a global industrial packaging products and services company based in Delaware, Ohio. Originally a barrel manufacturer, it now produces steel, fiber and plastic drums, IBCs, jerrycans, plastic bottles, closures, containerboard, corrugated products, and adhesives.

gb-group.name: GB Group
gb-group.description: GB Group plc, trading as GBG, is a UK-based company specializing in identity verification, location intelligence, and fraud prevention. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

globe-international.name: Globe International
globe-international.description: Globe International Limited is an Australian company founded in 1985 that produces footwear, clothing, and skateboard hardware. It operates internationally with offices in Australia, the USA, France, and China, and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

galaxy-resources.name: Galaxy Resources
galaxy-resources.description: Galaxy Resources Limited was an Australian public mining company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange. It merged with Orocobre in 2021 to form Allkem.

glu-mobile.name: Glu Mobile
glu-mobile.description: Glu Mobile LLC is an American developer and publisher of mobile games. Founded as Sorrent in 2001, it rebranded as Glu Mobile in 2005 and was acquired by Electronic Arts in 2021, becoming part of EA Mobile.

guess.name: Guess
guess.description: Guess?, Inc. is an American clothing company known for its black-and-white advertisements. It licenses its brand on fashion accessories including watches, jewelry, perfumes, bags, and shoes. The company is based in the United States.

gaz-group.name: GAZ Group
gaz-group.description: GAZ Group is a Russian automotive conglomerate headquartered in Nizhny Novgorod. It includes 18 manufacturing facilities across eight Russian regions, along with sales and service organizations.

gogo-inflight-internet.name: Gogo Inflight Internet
gogo-inflight-internet.description: Gogo Inc. is an American provider of in-flight broadband Internet and connectivity services for business aircraft, headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado. It developed the 2Ku satellite-based Wi-Fi technology and sold its Commercial Air business to Intelsat in 2020.

g-city-ltd.name: G City Ltd
g-city-ltd.description: G City Ltd, formerly Gazit Globe, is a global real estate company focused on owning, developing, and managing income-producing mixed-use properties including retail, office, and residential in densely populated urban areas.

genomic-health.name: Genomic Health
genomic-health.description: Genomic Health, Inc. was a company based in Redwood City, California, focusing on genetic research in cancer detection. It was acquired and merged with Exact Sciences Corporation in 2019.

group-lala.name: Group Lala
group-lala.description: Grupo Lala is a Mexican food processing company founded in 1949 and headquartered in Gómez Palacio, Durango. It is one of the largest dairy companies in the world following its acquisition of National Dairy. The company operates in the food industry.

ginkgo-bioworks.name: Ginkgo Bioworks
ginkgo-bioworks.description: Ginkgo Bioworks Holdings, Inc. is an American biotechnology company founded in 2008 by five MIT scientists. It uses genetic engineering to produce bacteria with industrial applications and went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021.

goodrx.name: GoodRx
goodrx.description: GoodRx Holdings, Inc. is an American healthcare company operating a telemedicine platform and a free website and mobile app. It tracks prescription drug prices across more than 75,000 U.S. pharmacies and provides drug coupons for discounts. The platform also allows users to consult doctors online and obtain prescriptions for certain medications.

gw-pharmaceuticals.name: GW Pharmaceuticals
gw-pharmaceuticals.description: GW Pharmaceuticals Limited is a British pharmaceutical company known for its cannabis-based treatments, including nabiximols for multiple sclerosis and Epidiolex for epilepsy. It was the first to gain market approval for a natural cannabis derivative. The company is a subsidiary of Jazz Pharmaceuticals.

greggs.name: Greggs
greggs.description: Greggs plc is a British bakery and fast food chain headquartered in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. It specializes in 'on-the-go' savory and sweet baked goods and has expanded into convenience and drive-through markets.

globe-telecom.name: Globe Telecom
globe-telecom.description: Globe Telecom, Inc. is a Philippine telecommunications company headquartered in Bonifacio Global City, Taguig. It operates one of the largest mobile, fixed-line, and broadband networks in the Philippines. Globe is the most-subscribed telecommunications network in the country.

giordano.name: Giordano
giordano.description: Giordano International Limited is an international retailer of men's, women's, and children's apparel and accessories. The company was founded in Hong Kong in 1981.

gea-group.name: GEA Group
gea-group.description: GEA Group AG is a German corporation headquartered in Düsseldorf, active mostly in the food and beverages sector. It is one of the world's largest suppliers of process technology and components in the food and beverages industry and other industries. The company is listed on the DAX stock exchange.

geberit.name: Geberit
geberit.description: Geberit is a Swiss multinational group specializing in manufacturing and supplying sanitary parts and related systems. It is a leader in its field in Europe and has a global presence through its subsidiaries.

gravity-corporation.name: Gravity Corporation
gravity-corporation.description: Gravity Co., Ltd. is a South Korean video game corporation. It is primarily known for developing the massively multiplayer online role-playing game Ragnarok Online.

goeasy.name: goeasy
goeasy.description: goeasy Ltd. is a Canadian alternative financial services company based in Mississauga, Ontario. It operates three business units: easyfinancial for loans to non-prime borrowers, easyhome for lease-to-own furniture sales, and LendCare for point-of-sale consumer financing.

gmm-grammy.name: GMM Grammy
gmm-grammy.description: GMM Grammy Public Company Limited is the largest media conglomerate entertainment company in Thailand. It operates in music, concert production, artist management, film and television production, and publishing. The company features top Thai artists such as Bird Thongchai and Tata Young.

givaudan-s-a.name: Givaudan S.A.
givaudan-s-a.description: Givaudan S.A. is a Swiss multinational company that manufactures flavors, fragrances, and active cosmetic ingredients. It is recognized as the world's largest company in the flavor and fragrance industry as of 2025.

guardant-health.name: Guardant Health
guardant-health.description: Guardant Health, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Palo Alto, California. It was co-founded by Helmy Eltoukhy and AmirAli Talasaz, who serve as co-chief executive officers.

gamco-investors.name: GAMCO Investors
gamco-investors.description: GAMCO Investors, Inc., formerly Gabelli Asset Management Company, is an American investment advice and brokerage services provider based in Rye, New York. It was founded and is majority owned by Mario Gabelli.

gci.name: GCI
gci.description: GCI Communication Corp is an Alaska-based telecommunications company providing Internet, landline, and cellular services. It operates through its own facilities and agreements and is a subsidiary of Liberty Capital Corporation.

gmr-group.name: GMR Group
gmr-group.description: GMR Group is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in New Delhi, founded in 1978 by Grandhi Mallikarjuna Rao. It includes companies in infrastructure, energy, and airports, and operates projects in India and internationally.

grg-banking.name: GRG Banking
grg-banking.description: GRG Banking is a Chinese listed company specializing in financial self-service products. It develops, manufactures, sells, and services ATMs, automated fare collection systems, and currency recognition and processing equipment.

gtx-incorporated.name: GTx Incorporated
gtx-incorporated.description: GTx, Inc. was a pharmaceutical company focused on drugs in the selective estrogen receptor modulator (SERM) and selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) classes. Its drug development included enobosarm (ostarine) and GTx-758. The company was based in the United States.

gvk.name: GVK
gvk.description: GVK Industries Limited is an Indian conglomerate headquartered in Hyderabad with interests in energy, airports, hospitality, transportation, real estate, pharmaceuticals, and technology. It acquired Australian coal mines in Queensland and plans a $10 billion investment in mine, rail, and port projects. Its flagship company is GVK Power & Infrastructure Limited.

gaia.name: Gaia
gaia.description: Gaia, Inc. is an American media company founded in 1988 and based in Louisville, Colorado. It owns Gaia TV, a subscription video on-demand service featuring original and licensed alternative media documentaries on wellness, spirituality, and conspiracy theories.

gain-capital.name: GAIN Capital
gain-capital.description: GAIN Capital Holdings, Inc. was a US-based provider of online trading services headquartered in Warren, New Jersey. It offered market access and trade execution in foreign exchange, CFDs, and exchange-based products to retail and institutional investors. The company was acquired by StoneX Group in 2020.

galena-biopharma.name: Galena Biopharma
galena-biopharma.description: Galena Biopharma, Inc. was a publicly traded pharmaceutical company based in San Ramon, California. Founded in Worcester, Massachusetts, it moved to Oregon in 2011 and then to San Ramon in 2015. In 2017, it was acquired by Sellas Life Sciences Group Ltd. and renamed Sellas Life Sciences Group, Inc.

galliford-try.name: Galliford Try
galliford-try.description: Galliford Try plc is a British construction company based in Uxbridge, England. It was formed in 2000 by merging Try Group and Galliford. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

gas-malaysia.name: Gas Malaysia
gas-malaysia.description: Gas Malaysia Berhad is a natural gas distribution company headquartered in Shah Alam, Malaysia. It operates three regional offices in Prai, Gebeng, and Pasir Gudang, along with seven branch offices throughout Peninsular Malaysia.

gates-corporation.name: Gates Corporation
gates-corporation.description: Gates Industrial Corporation plc, based in Denver, Colorado, manufactures power transmission belts and fluid power products used in industrial and automotive applications. The company operates sales and manufacturing facilities across North and South America, Europe, Asia, Australia, and the Middle East.

genon-energy.name: GenOn Energy
genon-energy.description: GenOn Energy, Inc., headquartered in Houston, Texas, is an energy company supplying electricity to wholesale customers in the United States. It is one of the largest independent power producers in the country, operating power generation capacity using natural gas, fuel oil, and coal.

genel-energy.name: Genel Energy
genel-energy.description: Genel Energy plc is a publicly listed oil exploration and production company based in London, with offices in Istanbul and Hargeisa. It holds interests in the Tawke production sharing contract in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq and licenses in Somaliland and Oman.

generac-holdings-inc.name: Generac Holdings Inc.
generac-holdings-inc.description: Generac Holdings Inc., headquartered in Waukesha, Wisconsin, manufactures backup power generation products for residential, commercial, and industrial markets. Its power systems range from 800 watts to 250 kilowatts and are distributed through dealers, retailers, and wholesalers.

genesco.name: Genesco
genesco.description: Genesco Inc. is an American publicly owned specialty retailer and wholesaler of branded and licensed footwear and accessories. Its brand portfolio includes Dockers, Johnston & Murphy, Journeys, and Schuh.

genesis-energy-limited.name: Genesis Energy Limited
genesis-energy-limited.description: Genesis Energy Limited is a New Zealand publicly listed company involved in electricity generation and retailing of electricity, natural gas, and LPG. It was formed during the 1998–99 reform of the New Zealand electricity sector and is 51% owned by the New Zealand Government.

genki-global-dining-concepts.name: Genki Global Dining Concepts
genki-global-dining-concepts.description: Genki Sushi is a Japanese chain of conveyor belt sushi restaurants established in 1990. The chain has expanded internationally with locations in Asia, Australia, and the United States, including California, Hawaii, and Washington.

gentex.name: Gentex
gentex.description: Gentex Corporation is an American electronics and technology company that designs and manufactures automatic-dimming rear-view mirrors and camera-based driver assistance systems for the automotive industry. It also produces dimmable aircraft windows and photoelectric smoke detectors for fire protection markets.

gentiva-health-services.name: Gentiva Health Services
gentiva-health-services.description: Gentiva Health Services is a provider of home health care, hospice, and related health services in the United States. It is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Before its acquisition by Kindred Healthcare in 2014, it was a Fortune 1000 company and part of the S&P 600 index.

genuine-parts-company.name: Genuine Parts Company
genuine-parts-company.description: Genuine Parts Company is an American distributor of automotive and industrial parts based in Atlanta, Georgia. Founded in 1928, it operates in multiple countries including the US, Canada, and several European nations. Its subsidiaries include Motion and NAPA Auto Parts.

georgia-power.name: Georgia Power
georgia-power.description: Georgia Power is an electric utility headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Established in 1902 as the Georgia Railway and Power Company, it began operations running streetcars in Atlanta as a successor to the Atlanta Consolidated Street Railway Company.

geron-corporation.name: Geron Corporation
geron-corporation.description: Geron Corporation is a biotechnology company based in Foster City, California. It specializes in developing and commercializing therapeutic products for cancer that inhibit telomerase.

gevo-inc.name: Gevo, Inc
gevo-inc.description: Gevo, Inc. is an American renewable chemicals and advanced biofuels company headquartered in Douglas County, Colorado. It develops bio-based alternatives to petroleum products using biotechnology and chemistry, focusing on sustainable raw materials like No. 2 dent corn to produce fuels and animal feed.

gezhouba-group.name: Gezhouba Group
gezhouba-group.description: China Gezhouba Group Company Limited is a Chinese construction and engineering company based in Wuhan, Hubei. It primarily constructs hydroelectric power plants, dams, roads, bridges, and other civil engineering projects in China and over 60 countries worldwide.

gitlab-inc.name: GitLab Inc.
gitlab-inc.description: GitLab Inc. is an American company that develops GitLab, an open-core DevOps software package. The software includes distributed version control, access control, bug tracking, task management, and wikis for projects.

greene-king.name: Greene King
greene-king.description: Greene King Limited is a British pub and brewing company founded in 1799 and based in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk. It owns brands like Hungry Horse and Farmhouse Inns. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by CK Assets in 2019.

glenmark-pharmaceuticals.name: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals
glenmark-pharmaceuticals.description: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. Founded in 1977, it manufactures generic drugs and active pharmaceutical ingredients. The company operates mainly in India, North America, and Europe and is publicly listed in India.

glimcher-realty-trust.name: Glimcher Realty Trust
glimcher-realty-trust.description: Glimcher Realty Trust was a real estate investment trust based in Columbus, Ohio, focusing on shopping mall investments. The company was acquired by Washington Prime Group in 2015.

global-bio-chem.name: Global Bio-Chem
global-bio-chem.hq: Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong
global-bio-chem.description: Global Bio-Chem Technology Group is a Chinese biotechnology company based in Hong Kong. It is owned by Changchun Dacheng Industry Group.

global-payments.name: Global Payments
global-payments.description: Global Payments Inc. is an American multinational financial technology company that provides payment technology to merchants, issuers, and consumers. It processes payments made through credit cards, debit cards, and digital and contactless payments. The company was named to the Fortune 500 in June 2021.

globant.name: Globant
globant.description: Globant is an IT and software development company founded in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and later headquartered in Luxembourg. It operates internationally with significant revenue from North America, Latin America, Europe, and new markets. The company was formed in 2003 by four founders.

globeimmune.name: GlobeImmune
globeimmune.description: GlobeImmune, Inc. is a clinical-stage public biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Louisville, Colorado. It develops therapeutic vaccines to treat cancer and infectious diseases using its Tarmogen immunotherapy platform based on genetically modified yeast. As of August 2014, it had no marketed products.

globe-life.name: Globe Life
globe-life.description: Globe Life is a life and health insurance provider based in McKinney, Texas, with executive offices also in Oklahoma City. It operates nationwide in the United States and is a subsidiary of Globe Life.

gloria-material-technology-corp.name: Gloria Material Technology Corp.
gloria-material-technology-corp.description: Gloria Material Technology Corp. is a specialty alloy manufacturer headquartered in Liouying industrial zone, Tainan, Taiwan. It is the only company in Taiwan with melting, forging, rolling, heat treating, and finishing processes for over 500 steel grades. Its main products include round and square bars.

golar-lng.name: Golar LNG
golar-lng.description: Golar LNG is a Bermuda-based company that owns and operates marine LNG infrastructure. It has developed floating LNG liquefaction terminals and Floating Storage and Regasification Units by converting existing LNG carriers. The company is also exploring floating production of blue and green ammonia and carbon reduction in LNG production.

golden-entertainment.name: Golden Entertainment
golden-entertainment.description: Golden Entertainment, Inc. is an American gambling company based in Enterprise, Nevada. It operates casinos and taverns and was formed in 2015 by the merger of Golden Gaming and Lakes Entertainment. It is the largest tavern operator in Nevada and owns eight casino resorts in Southern Nevada.

good-energy.name: Good Energy
good-energy.description: Good Energy Group PLC is a British energy company based in Chippenham, Wiltshire. It provides services in transport electrification and decentralized renewable energy generation, including domestic solar panels. The company was founded by Juliet Davenport and sold its wind and solar generation portfolio in 2022.

graco.name: Graco
graco.description: Graco Inc. is an American manufacturer of fluid-handling systems and equipment headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Founded in 1926, it produces spray-finishing, pumping, dispensing, and lubrication equipment for industrial and contractor applications. The company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

graftech.name: GrafTech
graftech.description: GrafTech International Ltd. is a manufacturer of graphite electrodes and petroleum coke essential for electric arc furnace steel production. It is headquartered in Brooklyn Heights, Ohio, and operates manufacturing facilities in France, Spain, Mexico, and Pennsylvania.

grafton-group.name: Grafton Group
grafton-group.description: Grafton Group plc is a builders merchants business headquartered in Ireland, operating in both the United Kingdom and Ireland. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

granite-construction.name: Granite Construction
granite-construction.description: Granite Construction Inc. is a civil construction company and aggregate producer founded and based in Watsonville, California. It is a member of the S&P 600 Index and owns or leases quarries in several Western states for extracting sands, gravel, and crushed stone.

graphic-packaging.name: Graphic Packaging
graphic-packaging.description: Graphic Packaging International is a Fortune 500 company based in Atlanta, Georgia. It designs and manufactures paperboard and folding cartons for consumer goods, especially beverages and packaged food. The company operates multiple paperboard mills across the United States that use recycled municipal wastewater in production.

gray-media.name: Gray Media
gray-media.description: Gray Media, Inc. is an American television broadcasting company headquartered in Atlanta. Founded in 1946, it is the third-largest TV station operator in the U.S., owning or operating 180 stations in 113 markets. Its stations range from large markets like Atlanta to small ones like North Platte, Nebraska.

great-west-lifeco.name: Great-West Lifeco
great-west-lifeco.description: Great-West Lifeco Inc. is a Canadian insurance-focused financial holding company operating in North America, Europe, and Asia through five subsidiaries. Its largest subsidiary is The Canada Life Assurance Company. The company is indirectly controlled by Paul Desmarais Jr. through Power Corporation of Canada.

great-plains-energy.name: Great Plains Energy
great-plains-energy.description: Great Plains Energy Incorporated was a holding company based in Kansas City, Missouri. It owned the electric utility Kansas City Power and Light Company and the energy management company Strategic Energy, LLC.

green-packet.name: Green Packet
green-packet.description: Green Packet is a technology company founded in 2000 by Puan Chan Cheong in Cupertino, California. It started as a software solutions company and later expanded into the broadband sector.

green-plains-renewable-energy.name: Green Plains Renewable Energy
green-plains-renewable-energy.description: Green Plains Inc. is an American ethanol fuel producer based in Omaha, Nebraska, founded in 2004. It is the third largest ethanol producer in North America, shipping about one billion gallons annually. The company was founded by Barry Ellsworth.

grocery-outlet.name: Grocery Outlet
grocery-outlet.description: Grocery Outlet Holding Corp. is an American discount closeout retailer with supermarket locations across several U.S. states. It offers discounted, overstocked, and closeout products from name-brand and private-label suppliers. The company operates stores in states including California, Oregon, and Pennsylvania.

group-1-automotive.name: Group 1 Automotive
group-1-automotive.description: Group 1 Automotive, Inc. is an international automotive retailer headquartered in the United States. It operates dealerships and collision centers in the U.S. and the U.K., selling new and used vehicles and providing maintenance, repair, and financial services.

grupo-aeroportuario-centro-norte.name: Grupo Aeroportuario Centro Norte
grupo-aeroportuario-centro-norte.description: Grupo Aeroportuario Centro Norte, known as OMA, is a Mexican airport operator based near Monterrey. It manages 13 airports in central and northern Mexico and is the fourth largest airport services company in Mexico by passenger traffic, serving about 15 million passengers annually.

grupo-aeroportuario-del-pacifico.name: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico
grupo-aeroportuario-del-pacifico.description: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico (GAP) is a Mexican airport operator headquartered in Guadalajara. It operates 12 airports in central and northwestern Mexico and two airports in Jamaica.

grupo-nutresa.name: Grupo Nutresa
grupo-nutresa.description: Grupo Nutresa S.A. is a Colombian multinational food processing conglomerate headquartered in Medellín. It was formerly known as Grupo Nacional de Chocolates S.A.

guangdong-investment.name: Guangdong Investment
guangdong-investment.description: Guangdong Investment Limited is a Chinese company incorporated in Hong Kong. It operates in property, infrastructure, energy, water supply, hotel management, and department store operations in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, and Dongguan.

guidewire-software.name: Guidewire Software
guidewire-software.description: Guidewire Software, Inc. is an American software company based in San Mateo, California. It provides an industry platform for property and casualty insurance carriers in the U.S. and worldwide. The company specializes in software solutions for the insurance sector.

gujarat-gas-limited.name: Gujarat Gas Limited
gujarat-gas-limited.description: Gujarat Gas Limited is an Indian natural gas distribution company headquartered in Gandhinagar. It operates primarily in Gujarat and is India's largest city gas distribution company. The company was established in 1980.

gulf-keystone-petroleum.name: Gulf Keystone Petroleum
gulf-keystone-petroleum.description: Gulf Keystone Petroleum Limited is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company operating in the Kurdistan region of Iraq. It is the operator of the Shaikan oil field and was listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2004.

guoco-group.name: Guoco Group
guoco-group.description: Guoco Group Limited is an investment holding company operating mainly in Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Mainland China. Its subsidiaries engage in investment management, property development, stock and commodity broking, insurance, and banking. It is part of the Hong Leong Group conglomerate in Malaysia.

guosen-securities.name: Guosen Securities
guosen-securities.description: Guosen Securities Company Limited is a Chinese state-owned financial services company headquartered in Shenzhen. It operates more than 70 branches and provides services including sales and trading, investment banking, research, and asset management across China and Hong Kong.

geox.name: Geox
geox.description: Geox S.p.A. is an Italian brand that manufactures shoes and clothing using breathable and waterproof fabrics.

grupo-radio-centro.name: Grupo Radio Centro
grupo-radio-centro.description: Grupo Radio Centro is a Mexico City-based owner and operator of radio stations. It owns 30 radio stations across Mexico and the United States, including 8 in Mexico City.

grupo-mexico.name: Grupo México
grupo-mexico.description: Grupo México is a Mexican conglomerate operating through divisions including Mining, Transportation, Infrastructure, and its foundation. It is involved in multiple sectors with mining as a key industry.

gs25.name: GS25
gs25.description: GS25 is a South Korean convenience store chain operated by GS Retail, a subsidiary of GS Group. Headquartered in Seoul, it operated 13,899 stores as of mid-2020, with plans to increase to over 18,000 stores by the end of 2024.

genasys.name: Genasys
genasys.description: Genasys Inc., based in San Diego, California, produces long-range acoustic devices used for hailing and mass notification. It offers software-as-a-service products for zone-based communication and secure messaging. The company was formerly known as American Technology Corporation and LRAD Corporation.

geneva-cantonal-bank.name: Geneva Cantonal Bank
geneva-cantonal-bank.description: Banque Cantonale de Genève (BCGE) is a Swiss limited company established under public law from the merger of two Geneva-based banks. It is one of the 24 cantonal banks in Switzerland.

glassbox-ltd.name: Glassbox Ltd
glassbox-ltd.description: Glassbox is an Israeli software company that provides digital analytics and tools to monitor user interactions on websites and mobile applications. Its platform captures, analyzes, and replays user sessions, supporting over one trillion digital interactions annually.

garmin-group.name: Garmin Group
garmin-group.description: Garmin Ltd. is an American multinational technology company based in Olathe, Kansas. It designs, develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes GPS-enabled products and other navigation, communication, sensor-based, and information products for automotive, aviation, marine, outdoors, and sport markets.

gotion.name: Gotion
gotion.description: Gotion High Tech, known as Gotion, is a Chinese manufacturer of lithium-ion batteries. As of 2025, it ranked fifth worldwide by battery capacity installed in electric vehicles.

gulf-space-technology.name: Gulf Space Technology
gulf-space-technology.description: Gulf Space Technology Public Company Limited is a Thai satellite operator providing satellite and telecommunication services since 1991. It operates a fleet of four satellites covering Asia, Oceania, and Africa. The company is a subsidiary of Intouch Holdings PCL, Thailand's largest telecommunications conglomerate.

giant-bicycles.name: Giant Bicycles
giant-bicycles.description: Giant Manufacturing Co. Ltd. is a Taiwanese bicycle manufacturer recognized as the world's largest bicycle designer and manufacturer. It has manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, the Netherlands, China, and Hungary, with plans to expand to Vietnam.

glatfelter.name: Glatfelter
glatfelter.description: Glatfelter was a global manufacturer of engineered solutions. It merged with Berry Global’s Health, Hygiene and Specialties Global Nonwovens and Films business to form Magnera Corporation, now the largest nonwovens company worldwide, providing specialty materials industry solutions.

great-wall-pan-asia-holdings.name: Great Wall Pan Asia Holdings
great-wall-pan-asia-holdings.description: Great Wall Pan Asia Holdings Limited is a property investment company based in Hong Kong, China.

grupo-bimbo.name: Grupo Bimbo
grupo-bimbo.description: Grupo Bimbo, S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican multinational food company operating in over 33 countries across the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Africa. It is listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange and is recognized as the largest bakery in the world.

globe-life-united-state.name: Globe Life
globe-life-united-state.description: Globe Life Inc. is an American financial services holding company based in McKinney, Texas. It operates through subsidiaries providing life insurance, annuity, and supplemental health insurance products.

grupo-casas-bahia.name: Grupo Casas Bahia
grupo-casas-bahia.description: Grupo Casas Bahia is a Brazilian retail company formed in 2010 through the merger of Casas Bahia and Ponto, owned by the Klein family and Grupo Pão de Açúcar respectively. It operates in the retail sector in Brazil.

guangshen-railway.name: Guangshen Railway
guangshen-railway.description: Guangshen Railway Co., Ltd. operates the Guangzhou-Shenzhen Railway, a 152-kilometre railway link in Guangdong, China. The company provides passenger and freight transportation services and cooperates with Hong Kong's MTR Corporation on the Guangdong Through Train service.

gruppo-mondadori.name: Gruppo Mondadori
gruppo-mondadori.description: Arnoldo Mondadori Editore S.p.A. is a publishing company based in Italy. It operates in the publishing industry, distinct from retail chains. The company is recognized as a major player in the Italian publishing sector.

grupo-exito.name: Grupo Éxito
grupo-exito.description: Grupo Éxito is a South American retail company operating 2,606 stores selling a wide range of food and non-food products. Originally a textiles maker and seller, it has diversified into a major grocer offering packaged foods, perishables, and department store products including electronics and furniture.

grasim-industries.name: Grasim Industries
grasim-industries.description: Grasim Industries Limited is an Indian manufacturing company based in Mumbai. Founded in 1947 as a textile manufacturer, it has diversified into textile raw materials, chemicals, cement, and financial services through subsidiaries like UltraTech Cement and Aditya Birla Capital.

gohealth.name: GoHealth
gohealth.description: GoHealth, Inc. is a US-based marketplace for Medicare plans including Medicare Advantage, MediGap, and Medicare Part D. It also offers an online marketplace for individual and short-term health insurance.

general-motors-do-brasil.name: General Motors do Brasil
general-motors-do-brasil.description: General Motors do Brasil is the largest subsidiary of General Motors in South America. It is one of the oldest and largest car producers in Brazil.

grupo-arcor.name: Grupo Arcor
grupo-arcor.description: Grupo Arcor is an Argentine food company specializing in confectioneries, founded in 1951 in Arroyito, Córdoba. It produces foodstuffs including sugar and chocolate confectioneries, cookies, and ice cream across 39 plants in Latin America. It is the world's top producer of hard candies and the largest processed food producer in Argentina, exporting to over 120 countries.

grupo-record.name: Grupo Record
grupo-record.description: Grupo Record is the third largest media company in Brazil, owning several television stations including Record and Record News. Founded in November 1989, it is owned by businessman and bishop Edir Macedo. The company operates within the Brazilian media industry.

gazprom-neftekhim-salavat.name: Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat
gazprom-neftekhim-salavat.description: Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat is a Russian petrochemicals company headquartered in Salavat, Bashkortostan. It specializes in processing hydrocarbons into about 150 petrochemicals, fertilizers, and petroleum products including gasoline and fuel oil.

gjensidige.name: Gjensidige
gjensidige.description: Gjensidige Forsikring ASA is a Norwegian insurance company headquartered in Oslo. Founded in 1816, it has subsidiaries in Denmark and Sweden and holds a significant market share in the Norwegian insurance market.

grupo-abril.name: Grupo Abril
grupo-abril.description: Grupo Abril is a Brazilian media conglomerate headquartered in São Paulo. It is the holding company of Editora Abril, publisher of the weekly newsmagazine Veja.

gamtel.name: Gamtel
gamtel.description: Gamtel is the principal telecommunications company in the Gambia, established in 1984 as a state-owned enterprise. It oversees telecommunications and internet services and helped build the country's internet infrastructure. The company is 99% government-owned and operates from its main offices in Banjul.

gum.name: GUM
gum.description: GUM is a shopping center located in Moscow, Russia. It was the main department store in many cities of the former Soviet Union and had similarly named stores in some Soviet republics and post-Soviet states.

galaxia-sm.name: Galaxia SM
galaxia-sm.description: Galaxia SM is a South Korean sports marketing and management company under Trinity Asset Management and SM Entertainment. It offers services including advertising, broadcast programming, content creation, digital marketing, event management, and production. The company operates in the media and entertainment sector.

grupa-tvn.name: Grupa TVN
grupa-tvn.description: TVN S.A. is a Polish media and entertainment group established in 1995. Its flagship TV channel is TVN, and the CEO is Katarzyna Kieli, who is also president and managing director of TVN Warner Bros. Discovery. The company operates in Poland.

goodwin-steel-castings.name: Goodwin Steel Castings
goodwin-steel-castings.description: Goodwin plc is a heavy engineering firm based in Stoke-on-Trent, Staffordshire, England. It specializes in the supply and fabrication of castings and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

gentoo-media.name: Gentoo Media
gentoo-media.description: Gentoo Media Inc. is a publicly traded company based in Malta operating in the iGaming affiliate marketing industry. It manages a network of over 150 websites that direct traffic to licensed online casinos and sports betting operators, focusing on lead generation, content marketing, and compliance monitoring.

globe-trade-centre.name: Globe Trade Centre
globe-trade-centre.description: Globe Trade Centre S.A. (GTC) is a real estate development group established in 1994, operating in Poland and several Central and Eastern European countries. It focuses on commercial and residential projects, emphasizing sustainable development with certifications like LEED and BREEAM.

gs-engineering-construction.name: GS Engineering & Construction
gs-engineering-construction.description: GS Engineering & Construction is part of GS Group, one of the largest South Korean conglomerates. GS Group includes various subsidiaries such as GS Holdings, GS Caltex, and GS E&C. It is recognized as the 8th largest chaebol in Korea by asset size as of 2019.

granite-real-estate.name: Granite Real Estate
granite-real-estate.description: Granite Real Estate Investment Trust is a Canadian REIT focused on acquiring, developing, owning, and managing industrial, warehouse, and logistics properties in North America and Europe. It was originally composed mainly of former holdings of Magna International.

goa-carbon-limited.name: Goa Carbon Limited
goa-carbon-limited.description: Goa Carbon Limited is an Indian petrochemical company engaged in manufacturing and selling Calcined Petroleum Coke. Established in 1967, it is the second largest producer in India with manufacturing facilities in Goa, Paradip, and Bilaspur.

genivar.name: Genivar
genivar.description: Genivar Inc. was a Canadian engineering consulting firm that became WSP Global in 2014. Its head office is located in Montreal, Quebec.

general-american-investors-company.name: General American Investors Company
general-american-investors-company.description: The General American Investors Company, Inc. is a closed-end fund managing a global portfolio primarily composed of United States securities, along with some international and private securities.

genesis-healthcare.name: Genesis HealthCare
genesis-healthcare.description: Genesis HealthCare, headquartered in Kennett Square, Pennsylvania, provides short-term post-acute, rehabilitation, skilled nursing, and long-term care services. It owns or operates 290 skilled nursing facilities across 25 states and supplies rehabilitation therapy to about 1,700 healthcare providers in 45 states and D.C.

genus-plc.name: Genus plc
genus-plc.description: Genus plc is a British company that sells elite genetics and biotechnology products to cattle and pig farmers. It is headquartered in Basingstoke, UK, and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

given-imaging.name: Given Imaging
given-imaging.description: Given Imaging Ltd. was an Israeli medical technology company producing diagnostic products for gastrointestinal disorders. It was dual-listed on NASDAQ and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Covidien in 2014, which later became part of Medtronic.

glentel.name: Glentel
glentel.description: Glentel Inc. is a Canadian telecommunications retailer based in Burnaby, British Columbia. It is jointly owned by BCE Inc. and Rogers Communications.

global-partners.name: Global Partners
global-partners.description: Global Partners LP is an American energy supply company organized as a master limited partnership. It focuses on importing and marketing petroleum products in North America, wholesaling crude oil, diesel, gasoline, heating oil, and kerosene.

golden-star-resources.name: Golden Star Resources
golden-star-resources.description: Golden Star Resources Ltd was a Canadian gold mining company that owned and operated the Wassa gold mine in Ghana. Headquartered in London with a registered office in Toronto, it was publicly listed on multiple stock exchanges. The company was acquired in 2022 by Chifeng Jilong Gold Mining.

grainger-plc.name: Grainger plc
grainger-plc.description: Grainger plc is a British residential property business headquartered in Newcastle upon Tyne. It is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

great-portland-estates.name: Great Portland Estates
great-portland-estates.description: Great Portland Estates plc is a British property development and investment company. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company converted to Real Estate Investment Trust status in January 2007.

greencore-group.name: Greencore Group
greencore-group.description: Greencore Group plc is an Irish food company established in 1991 after the privatisation of Irish Sugar. It mainly produces convenience foods for Ireland and the UK and is the largest sandwich manufacturer worldwide. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

grieg-seafood.name: Grieg Seafood
grieg-seafood.description: Grieg Seafood is an international seafood company based in Bergen, Norway. It operates fish farms in Norway, British Columbia, and Shetland, specializing in fresh Atlantic salmon. The company announced the sale of its Canadian salmon-farming operations to Cermaq in 2025.

guardian-capital-group.name: Guardian Capital Group
guardian-capital-group.description: Guardian Capital Group is a Canadian financial services company headquartered in Toronto. Founded in 1962, it provides investment management, financial advisory, mutual fund distribution, insurance, and corporate services. It has been publicly listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange since 1969.

guestlogix.name: GuestLogix
guestlogix.description: Guestlogix Inc. is a Toronto-based technology company providing onboard and off-board retail technology and merchandising systems. It was listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange but entered creditor protection in 2016. The company sold key assets and relaunched under new ownership in 2017.

gulf-power-company.name: Gulf Power Company
gulf-power-company.description: Gulf Power Company was an American electric utility headquartered in Pensacola, Florida. It provided electricity to over 450,000 customers in eight counties in the Florida panhandle and owned multiple power plants.

guotai-haitong-securities.name: Guotai Haitong Securities
guotai-haitong-securities.description: Guotai Haitong Securities is a securities firm in China that became the country's largest securities brokerage by asset value following its acquisition of Haitong Securities.

getin-holding.name: Getin Holding
getin-holding.description: Getin Holding S.A. is a financial holding company founded in Warsaw, Poland in 1996. It began as an electronic business center and became a leader in IT solutions for small and medium-sized Polish businesses, offering IT, CRM, and ERP services.

games-workshop.name: Games Workshop
games-workshop.description: Games Workshop Group PLC is a British manufacturer of miniature wargames based in Nottingham, England. Its best-known products are Warhammer and Warhammer 40,000.

gkn.name: GKN
gkn.description: GKN Ltd is a British multinational automotive and aerospace components business headquartered in Redditch, England. It traces its origins back to 1759 and was acquired by Melrose Industries plc in 2018. Melrose divested parts of GKN in 2023, listing them as Dowlais Group on the London Stock Exchange.

general-cable.name: General Cable
general-cable.industry: Manufacture of other electronic and electric wires and cables
general-cable.description: General Cable was an American multinational cable manufacturing company headquartered in Highland Heights, Kentucky. It manufactured and distributed copper, aluminum, and optical fiber cables. In 2018, it was acquired by the Italian group Prysmian.

goto.name: GoTo
goto.description: GoTo Technologies USA, Inc., formerly LogMeIn Inc., is a software as a service company based in Boston, Massachusetts. Founded in 2003, it provides unified communication and IT management software and was rebranded to GoTo in 2022.

george-weston-limited.name: George Weston Limited
george-weston-limited.description: George Weston Limited is a Canadian holding company founded in 1882. It controls Loblaw Companies Limited, Canada's largest supermarket retailer, and owns Choice Properties real estate investment trust. The company is majority owned by Wittington Investments, Ltd Canada.

gabon-telecom.name: Gabon Telecom
gabon-telecom.description: Gabon Telecom SA is the largest telecommunications company in Gabon. It manages the country's internet domain .ga and operates about 35,000 land lines. Its cellular phone service subsidiary, Libertis, serves 200,000 customers.

gambia-red-cross-society.name: Gambia Red Cross Society
gambia-red-cross-society.description: Gambia Red Cross Society, founded in 1966, originated as a branch of the British Red Cross in 1948. It was officially recognized by the International Committee of the Red Cross in 1974. The organization is headquartered in Banjul, The Gambia.

guinee-air-service.name: Guinee Air Service
guinee-air-service.description: Guinee Air Service was an airline based in Conakry, Guinea. Established in 1985, it operated domestic charter flights with its main base at Conakry International Airport.

general-posts-and-telecommunications-com.name: General Posts and Telecommunications Company
general-posts-and-telecommunications-com.description: The General Posts and Telecommunications Company (GPTC) is a state-owned organization responsible for postal and telecommunication services in Libya. It manages fixed telephony, satellite communications, mobile telephony in partnership with Al Madar and Libyana, and other internet service providers.

global-aviation-and-services-group.name: Global Aviation and Services Group
global-aviation-and-services-group.description: Global Aviation and Services Group is a Libyan charter airline based in Tripoli, founded in 2003. The airline is currently banned from flying in the EU.

guinness-nigeria.name: Guinness Nigeria
guinness-nigeria.description: Guinness Nigeria is a set of breweries in Nigeria distributing products under the Guinness label. The company is owned by Tolaram.

globacom.name: Globacom
globacom.description: Globacom Limited, known as Glo, is a Nigerian multinational telecommunications company founded in 2003 by Mike Adenuga. It operates in the telecommunications industry and is based in Nigeria.

groupement-aerien-senegalais.name: Groupement Aérien Sénégalais
groupement-aerien-senegalais.description: Groupement Aérien Sénégalais is the governmental airline of Senegal based in Dakar. Its main base is Dakar-Yoff-Léopold Sédar Senghor International Airport. The airline serves the Senegalese government.

golis-telecom-somalia.name: Golis Telecom Somalia
golis-telecom-somalia.description: Golis Telecom is the largest telecommunications operator in Puntland, northeastern Somalia. Founded in 2002, it offers GSM mobile, fixed line, and internet services, covering major cities and over 50 districts in Puntland.

ghana-broadcasting-corporation.name: Ghana Broadcasting Corporation
ghana-broadcasting-corporation.description: The Ghana Broadcasting Corporation was established by law in 1968 as a state, public service, and commercial broadcaster. It is headquartered in Accra, Ghana, and is funded through grants, commercials, and a television license fee.

ghana-news-agency.name: Ghana News Agency
ghana-news-agency.description: The Ghana News Agency (GNA) is a state-owned news agency in Ghana, founded in 1957 by Kwame Nkrumah. It was established with help from Reuters and served as a key source of news dissemination in Ghana and Africa. The agency was known for spreading the ideology of the African Revolution and contributing to African and Ghanaian emancipation.

gcb-bank.name: GCB Bank
gcb-bank.description: GCB Bank Limited, formerly Ghana Commercial Bank, is the largest bank in Ghana by total operating assets and industry deposits. It is licensed by the Bank of Ghana and absorbed deposits and assets from UT Bank and Capital Bank in 2017. The bank plays a significant role in Ghana's banking sector.

ghana-water-company-ltd.name: Ghana Water Company Ltd.
ghana-water-company-ltd.description: Ghana Water Limited is the sole government-owned water utility company in Ghana. It is responsible for the production, transmission, and distribution of potable water in urban areas across the country. The company was formerly known as Ghana Water Company Limited and other names.

ghana-red-cross-society.name: Ghana Red Cross Society
ghana-red-cross-society.description: The Ghana Red Cross Society is an international humanitarian organization established by an act of Parliament in 1958. It is affiliated with the International Federation of the Red Cross and Red Crescent and has its headquarters in Accra, Ghana.

ghana-national-petroleum-corporation.name: Ghana National Petroleum Corporation
ghana-national-petroleum-corporation.description: The Ghana National Petroleum Corporation is a state agency responsible for exploration, licensing, and distribution of petroleum-related activities in Ghana. It oversees the country's petroleum industry operations.

gh-one-tv.name: GH One TV
gh-one-tv.description: GHOne TV is a Ghana-based entertainment channel offering lifestyle, music, fashion, series, children's programs, comedy, and tourism content. Owned by Excellence In Broadcasting Networks, it is the 5th most watched TV station in Ghana.

globonews.name: GloboNews
globonews.description: GloboNews is a Brazilian news-based pay television channel owned by Canais Globo, a division of Globo. It operates within Brazil's journalism and media industry, providing news content via pay TV.

grupo-petropolis.name: Grupo Petrópolis
grupo-petropolis.description: Cervejaria Petrópolis is a Brazilian brewery headquartered in Petrópolis. It operates six industrial plants across Brazil and has operations in Germany and Paraguay.

giraffas.name: Giraffas
giraffas.description: Giraffas is a Brazilian fast-food chain founded in 1981, with its first store located in Lago Sul, Federal District. It began franchising in 1991 and has expanded across Brazil, Paraguay, and Miami in the United States.

grupo-rbs.name: Grupo RBS
grupo-rbs.description: Grupo RBS is a Brazilian media conglomerate founded in 1957. It is one of Brazil's largest communication groups and the largest affiliated with TV Globo, comprising radio, television, newspapers, and online news portals.

grupo-bloch.name: Grupo Bloch
grupo-bloch.description: Grupo Bloch was a Brazilian media conglomerate founded by the Bloch family after arriving in Rio de Janeiro in 1922. It published pamphlets, magazines, and launched Manchete magazine in 1953.

grupo-nd.name: Grupo ND
grupo-nd.description: Grupo ND is a Brazilian media conglomerate headquartered in Florianópolis, Santa Catarina. Founded in 2019 after splitting from Grupo RIC, it includes a newspaper, seven TV stations, three radio stations, and a website.

ggb-bearing-technology.name: GGB Bearing Technology
ggb-bearing-technology.description: GGB Bearing Technology manufactures self-lubricating and prelubricated plain bearings and tribological polymer coatings. It has production facilities in multiple countries including Brazil.

grupo-silvio-santos.name: Grupo Silvio Santos
grupo-silvio-santos.description: Grupo Silvio Santos is a Brazilian holding company founded by the billionaire media-man Silvio Santos. It operates as a conglomerate in Brazil.

garoto.name: Garoto
garoto.description: Chocolates Garoto S.A. is a Brazilian chocolate and confectionery company headquartered in Vila Velha, Espírito Santo. Founded in 1929 by Heinrich Meyerfreund, it was acquired by Nestlé in 2002.

grupo-folha.name: Grupo Folha
grupo-folha.description: Grupo Folha is a Brazilian media conglomerate and the second largest in the country after Grupo Globo. It was founded by Octávio Frias and has been led by his son Luiz Frias since 1992. The company operates in the media industry in Brazil.

grupo-bandeirantes-de-comunicacao.name: Grupo Bandeirantes de Comunicação
grupo-bandeirantes-de-comunicacao.description: Grupo Bandeirantes de Comunicação is a Brazilian media conglomerate founded with the creation of Rádio Bandeirantes in 1937. Founded by João Saad, it has been chaired by his son Johnny Saad since 1999. The group operates in the media industry in Brazil.

global-aviation.name: Global Aviation
global-aviation.description: Global Aviation Operations (Pty) Ltd is a South African airline headquartered in Johannesburg and based at OR Tambo International Airport. The company provides aviation services from this major hub. It is part of South Africa's airline industry.

general-motors-of-argentina.name: General Motors of Argentina
general-motors-of-argentina.description: General Motors de Argentina S.R.L. is the Argentine subsidiary of US-based General Motors. It is headquartered in Vicente López, Buenos Aires, with a factory in Alvear, Santa Fe Province. The company operates in the automotive industry.

grupo-telefe.name: Grupo Telefe
grupo-telefe.description: Grupo Telefe is an Argentine media company founded in 1989. It operates the license for LS84 TV Channel 11 in Buenos Aires and other stations in Córdoba and Santa Fe. The company is headquartered in Martínez, Buenos Aires Province.

grupo-breca.name: Grupo Breca
grupo-breca.description: Grupo Breca, also known as Grupo Brescia, is a Peruvian business conglomerate founded over 130 years ago. It operates in Peru and other Latin American countries. The name 'Breca' reflects the founders' surnames Brescia and Cafferata.

grupo-cisneros.name: Grupo Cisneros
grupo-cisneros.description: Grupo Cisneros is a privately held, family-owned conglomerate headquartered in Coral Gables, Florida, with historical roots in Venezuela. It focuses on media entertainment, digital media, property investment, tourism development, and consumer products, reaching 550 million Spanish and Portuguese-speaking consumers worldwide.
