globovision.name: Globovisión
globovision.description: Globovisión is a 24-hour television news network broadcasting over-the-air in several Venezuelan regions and available nationwide via cable and satellite. It also reaches audiences in the United States and multiple Latin American countries through various cable packages.

great-mission-housing-venezuela.name: Great Mission Housing Venezuela
great-mission-housing-venezuela.description: Great Mission Housing Venezuela is a government program launched in 2011 to provide housing for people living in precarious conditions. It is part of the Bolivarian missions and has delivered millions of houses since its inception. The program is a key social housing initiative in Venezuela.

grupo-argos.name: Grupo Argos
grupo-argos.description: Grupo Argos S.A is a Colombian conglomerate with significant investments in cement and energy. Its cement operations span Colombia, the United States, Panama, Honduras, and the Caribbean. The company also invests in port facilities and real estate within Colombia.

grupo-aval.name: Grupo Aval
grupo-aval.description: Grupo Aval is a Colombian holding company involved in financial activities including banking, telecommunications, and real estate across Colombia and Central America. It is controlled by Luis Carlos Sarmiento, who owns about 80 percent of its shares.

grupo-sura.name: Grupo Sura
grupo-sura.description: Grupo de Inversiones Suramericana is a multilatin financial services company founded in 1945 in Colombia. It is listed on the Colombia Stock Exchange and included in the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices.

gb-corp.name: GB Corp
gb-corp.description: GB Corp, formerly Ghabbour Group, is an Egyptian manufacturer of automobiles, buses, trucks, and motorcycles. The company is located in Cairo and operates within the automotive industry.

grupo-poma.name: Grupo Poma
grupo-poma.description: Grupo Poma is a family-owned conglomerate based in El Salvador and one of the 50 largest companies in Central America. Led by Fernando Poma, its business activities include automobile dealerships, real estate development, industrial manufacturing, hotels, telecommunications investments, and non-profit organizations.

golden-wings-aviation.name: Golden Wings Aviation
golden-wings-aviation.description: Golden Wings Aviation South Sudan was a privately owned airline based in Juba, South Sudan. It operated regionally as an affiliate of South African carrier Golden Wings Aviation under a South African Air Operator's Certificate.

grupo-mvs-mi-vrga.name: Grupo MVS mi vrga
grupo-mvs-mi-vrga.description: Grupo MVS is a Mexican media conglomerate owning various media assets including MASTV, MVS Radio with four national networks, MVS Televisión with seven pay TV networks, E-Go wireless broadband, and Dish México.

grupo-cie.name: Grupo CIE
grupo-cie.description: Grupo CIE is a Mexican entertainment and media company leading the Latin American entertainment sector. It operates venues, auditoriums, and theme parks throughout Latin America and promotes live events, commercial fairs, and exhibitions. The company also operates ticketing sites including Ticketmaster Mexico and Ticketmaster Brazil.

grupo-reforma.name: Grupo Reforma
grupo-reforma.description: Grupo Reforma is the largest printed media company in Mexico and Latin America. It publishes ten daily newspapers in five cities, including leading newspapers in Mexico City, Monterrey, and Guadalajara. It also publishes the daily Metro in multiple cities and the afternoon tabloid El Sol in Monterrey.

gt-global.name: GT Global
gt-global.description: GT Global is one of the largest companies in northeastern Mexico, located in Tampico, Tamaulipas. Its main products include finance, automobiles, plastics, and tourism services. The company operates in multiple sectors within Mexico.

grupo-elektra.name: Grupo Elektra
grupo-elektra.description: Grupo Elektra is a Mexican financial and retail conglomerate founded in 1950. It operates over seven thousand points of contact across Mexico, the United States, and Central America through commercial and financial divisions. It is owned by Grupo Salinas.

grupo-famsa.name: Grupo Famsa
grupo-famsa.description: Grupo Famsa is a Mexican retail company owning Famsa department stores. In 2023, it operated 21 stores and 21 personal loan branches in Texas. It was one of the most important retail stores in Mexico.

gamesa.name: Gamesa
gamesa.hq: San Nicolás de los Garza, Mexico
gamesa.description: Gamesa is Mexico's largest manufacturer of cookies and also produces flour, ready-to-eat cereals, and related products. Headquartered in San Nicolás de los Garza, Nuevo León, it has production facilities in Mexico and Colombia. Gamesa was acquired by PepsiCo in 1990.

grupo-modelo.name: Grupo Modelo
grupo-modelo.description: Grupo Modelo is a large Mexican brewery owned by Anheuser-Busch InBev that exports beer worldwide. Its export brands include Corona, Modelo, and Pacífico, and it holds exclusive rights in Mexico for importing and distributing Anheuser-Busch beers.

gecamines.name: Gécamines
gecamines.hq: Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo
gecamines.description: Gécamines is a state-controlled commodity trading and mining company headquartered in Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Founded in 1966 as a successor to Union Minière du Haut-Katanga, it focuses on exploration, research, exploitation, and production of minerals including copper and cobalt.

great-lakes-business-company.name: Great Lakes Business Company
great-lakes-business-company.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
great-lakes-business-company.description: Great Lakes Business Company was an airline owner and operator in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The company was involved in the aviation industry within the country.

gepetrol.name: GEPetrol
gepetrol.description: GEPetrol is the national oil company of Equatorial Guinea, founded in 2002 by presidential decree. It reports to the Ministry of Mines, Industry and Energy and is headquartered in Malabo. Teresa Isabel Nnang Avomo is the company's director.

guinea-ecuatorial-airlines.name: Guinea Ecuatorial Airlines
guinea-ecuatorial-airlines.description: Guinea Equatorial Airlines (GEASA) is an airline based in Malabo, Equatorial Guinea. Established in 1996, it operates domestic charter services from Malabo International Airport.
